definitions.explanation: The process of demolishing and rebuilding existing structures in an area, typically to modernize or revitalize an urban district. A major topic in Japanese urban planning.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}の{再開発|さいかいはつ}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Redevelopment in front of the station has begun.

examples.japanese: この{地区|ちく}は{再開発|さいかいはつ}で{大|おお}きく{変|か}わった。
examples.english: This district changed dramatically through redevelopment.

examples.japanese: {再開発|さいかいはつ}{計画|けいかく}に{対|たい}して{住民|じゅうみん}から{反対|はんたい}の{声|こえ}が{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: Residents are raising voices of opposition to the redevelopment plan.

notes:
{再開発|さいかいはつ} refers to the demolition and rebuilding of existing structures in an area, typically to modernize or revitalize an urban district.

FORMS:
{再|さい} (re-) + {開発|かいはつ} (development). The prefix {再|さい} indicates doing something again.

USAGE:
Very common in news about urban planning. Major redevelopment projects in Tokyo ({渋谷|しぶや}, {品川|しながわ}, {虎ノ門|とらのもん}, etc.) are frequently discussed in the media. Often involves controversy over displacement of residents and small businesses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再開発|さいかいはつ}{計画|けいかく}: redevelopment plan
- {再開発|さいかいはつ}{事業|じぎょう}: redevelopment project
- {再開発|さいかいはつ}エリア: redevelopment area
- {駅前|えきまえ}{再開発|さいかいはつ}: station-area redevelopment
- {市街地|しがいち}{再開発|さいかいはつ}: urban district redevelopment
